name: shiftswifthr-mobile-app
description: ShiftSwift HR — unified mobile app (bundled login + employee/admin portals)

scripts.sync:ios: npm run sync:www && npx cap sync ios
scripts.sync:android: npm run sync:www && npx cap sync android
scripts.sync:all: npm run sync:www && npx cap sync
scripts.brand:all: npm run brand:ios && npm run brand:android
scripts.ios:deploy: npm run sync:ios && npm run brand:ios && npx cap run ios
scripts.android:deploy: npm run sync:android && npm run brand:android && npx cap run android
scripts.ios:sync: npm run sync:www && rsync -a www/ ios/App/App/public/ && xattr -cr www ios/App/App/public 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.appstore:release: npm run appstore:archive && npm run appstore:upload
scripts.appstore:prepare: npm run screenshots:prepare && npm run appstore:archive
scripts.playstore:release: npm run playstore:archive && npm run playstore:upload
